output.summary: The zero-deviation record is an artifact of reporting suppression. NCRs fell from about 14 per month to zero right after the February bonus penalty, while independent lot rejections (0.8% to 1.3%) and customer complaints (11 to 31 ppm) rose. Line 3's output advantage comes from borrowed Line 1 and 4 technicians (output per technician-hour is unchanged), not from transferable practices. 71% of traceable luer-leak complaints trace to Line 3 lots, consistent with undocumented rework. The tubing supplier switch does not explain this, since complaints began rising before it and other lines use the same tubing. Do not roll out Line 3. Remove the penalty, offer amnesty, and run an independent investigation. Do not unmask the reporter. Who directed the lending remains unknown.
